kehillah_sermon_pick_appeal_effect = {
	scope:kehillah_sermon_holder = {
		remove_variable = kehillah_sermon_cand_grounded
		remove_variable = kehillah_sermon_cand_newer
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = kehillah_sermon_best value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = kehillah_sermon_newest value = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_mekhilta } NOT = { scope:kehillah_sermon_holder.var:kehillah_sermon_cited_1 ?= flag:work_mekhilta } kehillah_lib_standing_work_mekhilta > local_var:kehillah_sermon_best }
		set_local_variable = { name = kehillah_sermon_best value = kehillah_lib_standing_work_mekhilta }
		scope:kehillah_sermon_holder = { set_variable = { name = kehillah_sermon_cand_grounded value = flag:work_mekhilta } }
	}
	if = {
